Order on I.A. No.2 of 2023:
The applicants/petitioners are directed to implead Smt. Rachana, Smt. Meena Devi and Shri Devi Sahai as respondent nos.4, 5 & 6.
The necessary incorporation be carried out during the course of the day.

Order on main petition:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners.

Present petition has been filed challenging the order dated 10.02.2023 whereby on an Satay Pal And 2 Others vs Yashin Malik And 2 Others on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88206942/
1 application filed by respondent nos.4, 5 & 6, the name of the petitioners have been deleted from the claim petition.

entities.text: Satay Pal And 2 Others vs Yashin Malik And 2 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The facts, in brief, are that the petitioners alongwith Smt. Rachana, Smt. Meena Devi and Shri Devi Sahai had filed a petition claiming compensation under the Motor Vehicle Act.

Respondent No.4 is the wife of the deceased, respondent no.5 is the mother of the deceased and respondent no.6 is the father of the deceased, whereas the petitioners are brothers and sisters of the deceased and claim to be dependent on the deceased as well as the legal representatives.
An application was moved by respondent no.4 seeking to delete the name of the petitioners from the list of the claimants who had filed the petition.
The said application was allowed holding that the petitioners being brothers and sisters would not fall within the definition of legal representatives.

The petitioner relies on the judgment of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation, Ahmedabad v. Ramanbhai Prabhatbhai & Anr.; 1987 SCR (3) 404 and N. Jayasree & Ors. v. Cholamandalam Ms General Insurance Company Ltd.; Civil Appeal No.6451 of 2021 decided on 25.10.2021.

entities.text: Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation, Ahmedabad v. Ramanbhai Prabhatbhai & Anr.; 1987 SCR (3) 404
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: N. Jayasree & Ors. v. Cholamandalam Ms General Insurance Company Ltd.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the order impugned which has been passed deleting the names only on the plain reading of the provisions of the Act without there being any consideration to the law as laid and referred above, the impugned order dated 10.02.2023 is quashed.
The matter is remanded to MACT, Bulandshahar to pass a fresh order after hearing the parties including respondent nos.4, 5 & 6 and after taking into account the judgments as referred above.
The writ petition is disposed offin above terms.
